name: Break-in, theft & attack
axis: Leaf axis: the job the device does (lock a door; restrain a door or window; lock a loose item; store securely; detect and sound; watch and answer the door; receive mail; deter climbing and glass break).

name: Fire, smoke & gas
axis: Leaf axis: the device job, detect or suppress.

name: Household injury hazards
axis: Leaf axis: the site of the hazard and the job done there (stairs and openings; cabinets, appliances and furniture; edges, sockets and knobs; windows and doors; watching a room). Child, baby, older adult and pet are user tags.

name: Latches & restraints for cabinets, appliances and furniture
Pests
axis: Leaf axis: the control method (trap; bait; spray or vaporise; repel; kill on contact; exclude). Target pest is a tag.

name: Parts and accessories made for one B8 object
Land
axis: Leaf axis: land cover and principal use. Land is filed by its principal land use whether or not it carries buildings; dwellings and farm buildings on it are the facet `improvements`. Kind axis: crop, cover or holding.

name: Dwellings
axis: Leaf axis: what is owned against the building around it (a whole house; a unit inside a building; a whole building of two or more dwellings; a dwelling kept in place that is not a building).

name: Other buildings & structures
axis: Leaf axis: what the building or structure is for. Kind axis: the use-named building or structure; roof shape, material, wall construction, size and attached or freestanding (C12) are attributes.

name: Houses
axis: Kind axis: attachment to neighbouring dwellings.

name: Flats and maisonettes
axis: Kind axis: levels in the unit.

name: Multi-unit residential buildings
axis: Kind axis: one kind (`units_in_building` is the facet).

name: Dwellings kept in place that are not buildings
axis: Kind axis: physical form, listed from least to most fixed. Build standard and site licence are `standard_met` and C17 rows, never the test.

name: Pools
axis: Kind axis: one kind; construction (fibreglass, vinyl liner, concrete or gunite) is the attribute `construction` (G-17, provisional until a non-US seller is attested).

name: Other buildings by function
axis: Kind axis: the function the building is made for (K-62); market never divides them, and finer functions are named forms.

name: Cutting & sawing
axis: Leaf axis: tool family (hand, powered and machine versions of a family share a leaf); kind order by `drive` and `mount`, manual hand-held to stationary machine, then size.

name: Drilling, driving & turning
axis: Leaf axis: tool family; kind order by `drive` and `mount`, manual hand-held to stationary machine, then size.

name: Shaping & finishing
axis: Leaf axis: tool family; kind order by `drive` and `mount`, manual hand-held to stationary machine, then size.

name: Striking & fastening
axis: Leaf axis: tool family; kind order by `drive` and `mount`, manual hand-held to stationary machine, then size.

name: Joining & heat
axis: Leaf axis: joining process; kind order by `drive` and `mount`, then size.

name: Measuring, layout & testing
axis: Leaf axis: what is measured or marked (K-147, K-148); kind order by resolution, coarse to fine.

name: Lifting, access & materials handling
axis: Leaf axis: what is lifted, reached or moved; kind order by height or load ascending.

name: Power & air supply
axis: Leaf axis: what is supplied; kind order by output ascending.

name: Parts and accessories made for one tool
Cameras
axis: Leaf axis: recording technology (what the image is recorded on), admitted as a kind-level split by C10(b) (D-3): digital, film, instant.

name: Light
axis: Leaf axis: what the object does with light (makes a flash; gives continuous light; shapes light; holds the source or the studio backdrop).

name: Darkroom and processing
axis: Leaf axis: the stage of the darkroom process the object serves, with materials used across stages in the last leaf (C14(c)).

name: Parts and accessories made for one camera or lens
Dolls, figures & soft toys
axis: Leaf axis: the form of the figure played with or displayed. Display group: Dolls, figures & soft toys.

name: Scale models & model railways
axis: Leaf axis: the object modelled at scale, by its form (two leaves). Kit or built (`assembly`), subject, material and scale are attributes (E-7, E-14). Display group: Models, kits & model railways.

name: Games
axis: Leaf axis: the component set owned (E-9). Every published board, card, tile, dice or tabletop game is a maker-bound named form of its kind, publisher the maker, held in a C2(g) register (E-6, CV-45). Display group: Board, card & tabletop games.

name: Role play & other toys
axis: Leaf axis: the kind of play the toy is made for (pretend, sound, early handling, skill and motion, party and novelty); infant and preschool are user tags, not a leaf. Display group: Pretend play & other toys.

name: Parts and accessories made for one toy or game
Paintings
axis: Leaf axis: none (`leaf = null`). Kind axis: binder or medium of the paint; support and ground (canvas, panel, paper, silk) are attributes.

name: Drawings
axis: Leaf axis: none (`leaf = null`). Kind axis: drawing medium; use (illustration, comic art, animation) is a tag.

name: Prints
axis: Leaf axis: family of printing process, oldest first. Kind axis: the technique. Every print is filed by how it was printed; issue form (poster) and support are attributes.

name: Photographs
axis: Leaf axis: process class, by chronology of invention. Kind axis: the process. Every photographic print is filed by process and carries `process` and `mount_format`.

name: Sculpture
axis: Leaf axis: material family that makes the form. Kind axis: the material or material-defined type. Figurines are kinds in these leaves; there is no figurine sub-family. Form (freestanding, wall-object, bust, relief, outdoor, installation, kinetic, netsuke) and size are attributes.

name: Wood and other carved organic material
Textile and fibre hangings
axis: Leaf axis: none (`leaf = null`). Kind axis: the named object.

name: Calligraphy
axis: Leaf axis: none (`leaf = null`). Kind axis: the named object; script styles and traditions are named forms with region tags, hanging scroll and handscroll are `mount_format` attributes.

name: Collage, mosaic and mixed work
axis: Leaf axis: none (`leaf = null`). Kind axis: the named object.

name: Altars, shrines and sacred images
axis: Leaf axis: the form of the sacred focus (altar or shrine; flat image; three-dimensional image; relic and its container). Sub-family test: what is set up to be venerated. Display group: Home altars, shrines and sacred images.

name: Personal devotion aids
axis: Leaf axis: how the aid is used (counted; knelt or sat on; turned or flown; held, carried or used to bless). Sub-family test: what the practitioner holds, counts, kneels on or carries to pray. Display group: Prayer and devotion aids.

name: Held, carried or used to bless
Ritual vessels, implements and instruments
axis: Leaf axis: how the object is handled in the rite (vessel; hand implement; text-bearing object; sound-maker). Sub-family test: what is handled in the rite. Display group: Ritual vessels, implements and sacred scrolls.

name: Light, incense and offerings
axis: Leaf axis: what is lit, burned or set out (lamp and candle; incense and its burner; offering vessel and stand). Sub-family test: what is lit, burned or set out. Display group: Lamps, candles, incense and offerings.

name: Divination and esoteric tools
axis: Leaf axis: deck, or other tool. Sub-family test: what is read or cast. Display group: Tarot, oracle and divination.

name: The dead
axis: Leaf axis: coffin; urn; marker; furnishing. Sub-family test: what holds the remains, marks the dead, or covers the body or coffin. Display group: Funeral and memorial.

name: Parts and accessories made for one religious or funerary object
axis: Leaf axis: the object served (CV-17, C5(d); opened by F-19). Display group: Fittings for one sacred or funerary object.

name: Monitoring and testing devices
axis: Leaf axis: quantity measured or condition tested. Every test and monitor is here, whatever condition it serves.

name: Therapy devices
axis: Leaf axis: therapy delivered.

name: Mobility and transfer aids
axis: Leaf axis: how the body is supported or moved.

name: Daily-living and care aids
axis: Leaf axis: daily task or care need.

name: Sensory and communication aids
axis: Leaf axis: sense or channel compensated.

name: Medicines
axis: Leaf axis: symptom or condition group (the one place in H2 where condition is the leaf axis). All medicines are here, prescription or not; the kind is the labelled use class, and a product labelled for two uses is filed by the use printed first on the pack. A traditional or homeopathic product labelled for a use goes to that use class with `tradition` as an attribute; leaf 0 holds only products with no labelled use.

name: Supplements
axis: Leaf axis: ingredient class. A single-ingredient product is the kind named by its ingredient; a product that mixes ingredient classes is a multi-ingredient supplement. Supplements sold for skin, hair or nails, collagen drinks included, are here. Kinds are seeded from the NIH fact-sheet list and enter on one fetched page each, uncapped (H-3).

name: Sports, meal and medical nutrition
axis: Leaf axis: role in training or meals. Sports and meal-replacement products are here in every form (powders, bars, gels, ready-to-drink shakes, tablets).

name: Contraception, barriers and breastfeeding
axis: Leaf axis: purpose, to prevent pregnancy or infection, or to feed. Tests are in H2.1 and medicines in H2.6.

name: First aid and wound care
axis: Leaf axis: form of supply.

name: Supports, braces and prostheses
axis: Leaf axis: what the object does to the body part. Body region is part of the kind name.

name: Parts and accessories made for one device
axis: Leaf axis: device family served. This sub-family is exempt from the level-1 axis (C5(d)).

name: Templates and production packs
axis: Kind axis: file kind for the target tool.

name: 3D assets
axis: Kind axis: asset part.

name: Domain names
axis: Kind axis: eligibility class of the TLD (I-12); each TLD is a named form.

name: Tokens
axis: Kind axis: token form (I2-O1); token standards, then NFT collections (maker-bound), are named forms.

name: Rice, grains & flours
axis: Leaf axis: the grain and its form as sold, an ordered key, first yes: (1) milled to flour or meal: Flours & meals; (2) a rice grain, whole or flattened: Rice; (3) oats, or a cereal made to eat at breakfast: Oats & breakfast cereals; (4) otherwise: Other grains, pseudo-cereals & starch pearls.

name: Pasta & noodles
axis: Leaf axis: the dough base, an ordered key, first yes: (1) potato dough: Gnocchi; (2) buckwheat in the dough: Buckwheat noodles; (3) egg dough: Egg pasta & egg noodles; (4) rice flour or a pure starch (mung bean, potato): Rice & starch noodles; (5) durum wheat semolina, including whole-wheat durum: Durum wheat pasta; (6) soft wheat flour: Soft-wheat noodles; (7) any other flour: Other-flour pasta & noodles. Fresh or dried is the attribute `storage_state`. Cuts within a shape family (spaghetti, penne, fusilli) are named forms of the family kind; a maker line is a maker-bound named form with its cut recorded (J-1).

name: Pulses
axis: Leaf axis: the species group. Whole or split (dal), dried or tinned, and cooked plain in water or brine are attributes: a dried and a tinned pulse of one species are one kind. Heirloom varieties are named forms.

name: Nuts & seeds
axis: Leaf axis: the plant group of the nut or seed. Form (in shell, shelled, blanched, flaked, ground), roasting and salting are attributes, so ground almonds are almonds. Every nut, chestnut and coconut is here (K-54).

name: Oils, fats & vinegars
axis: Leaf axis: the kind of product: plant oil, solid fat, vinegar or cooking liquid.

name: Spices, herbs & salt
axis: Leaf axis: the form of the seasoning: single spice, dried herb, blend, salt.

name: Sugars, honey & syrups
axis: Leaf axis: the sweetener type.

name: Spreads, pastes & dips
axis: Leaf axis: the kind of spread. A spread, paste or dip eaten with other food is here whatever it is made from, except spreads and fresh cheeses made from milk (J3) (K-44).

name: Sauces, condiments & stocks
axis: Leaf axis: the product type as standards and shelves class it, an ordered key, first yes: (1) a soy sauce: Soy sauces; (2) another seasoning made by fermenting beans, grain or fish: Other fermented seasonings; (3) a stock or bouillon in any form: Stocks & bouillon; (4) a paste used as a cooking ingredient: Cooking & seasoning pastes; (5) a sauce to cook with or pour over pasta: Cooking & pasta sauces; (6) otherwise: Table sauces, condiments & dressings.

name: Baking ingredients
axis: Leaf axis: the function in the bake or the brew. Holds only products no other family holds; flour, sugar and nuts stay in their own families.

name: Tofu, tempeh & meat alternatives
axis: Leaf axis: how the protein food is made, an ordered key, first yes: (1) texturised or formed to imitate a meat product: Plant-based meat analogues; (2) washed from wheat dough: Seitan & wheat gluten; (3) a whole bean fermented: Tempeh & fermented beans; (4) set as a curd: Tofu & bean-curd products. Firmness and format are attributes.

name: Shoes (closed, non-athletic)
axis: Leaf axis: closure and vamp cut. Dress-shoe kinds are set by lacing and cut.

name: Fastened: laces or a buckle close the shoe over a covered instep.
Slip-on: no fastening; the vamp covers the instep.
Court cut and strap: a low-cut vamp leaves the instep open; the shoe is held by its cut or by a strap.
Boots
axis: Leaf axis: shaft height of the kind's canonical form. A kind keeps its name when one model departs from the canonical height.

name: Calf (to the calf, below the knee)
Slippers (soft, unstructured footwear without a rigid or moulded outsole: the sole is a thin, flexible layer of felt, fabric, leather, suede, foam or thin rubber; no leaf)
Over-footwear (worn over another shoe to cover the foot; no leaf)
Parts and accessories made for one pair of shoes (no leaf)
Abrasives cut for one power tool
Tops
axis: Leaf axis: construction family of the top (cut-and-sew, woven shirt, knit, sweatshirt jersey).

name: Bottoms
axis: Leaf axis: garment form (jeans, trousers, shorts, skirts).

name: Dresses, one-piece garments and sets
axis: Leaf axis: garment form (dress or two-piece set; one-piece work or play garment; tailored set; draped or wrapped length).

name: Outerwear
axis: Leaf axis: silhouette: sleeved and hip length or shorter; sleeved and below the hip; sleeveless; cape form.

name: Underwear, hosiery, sleepwear and swimwear
axis: Leaf axis: garment form family (worn under; worn on legs and feet; worn to sleep or lounge; worn in or beside water).

name: Headwear and head protection
axis: Leaf axis: none: 12 kinds, so the leaf level is skipped; hats and caps first, then protective kinds by body zone from head to face.

name: Hands, neck and waist wear
axis: Leaf axis: none: 8 kinds, so the leaf level is skipped; kinds ordered by body zone (neck, arm, hand, waist).

name: Parts and accessories made for one garment
axis: Leaf axis: object served: the garment served; provisional and small; kinds ordered by the garment they serve.

name: Computers
axis: Leaf axis: none (9 kinds, C5(b)). Kind order: current machines as shops list them (laptop, then desktop forms from large to small), then the build-it-yourself body and the single-board computer, then the historic classes, which carry an era tag.

name: PC parts
axis: Leaf axis: build slot, the parts list a builder fills, in the order of PCPartPicker's list (CPU, CPU cooler, motherboard, memory, storage, video card, case, power supply) [S01], then the expansion cards and internal cables that UK and Japanese shops carry in the same parts tree [S02, S06]. Compatibility codes (socket, chipset, DDR and PCIe generation, M.2 length, board, case and PSU form factor) are attributes, not kinds.

name: Peripherals and desk setup
axis: Leaf axis: device family on the desk (what the user handles or sets up beside the computer), with the mechanical-keyboard hobby's kits and parts as their own shelf beside keyboards, as keyboard shops show them (keyboards, kits, switches, keycaps, plates and stabilisers).

name: Printing and scanning
axis: Leaf axis: none (8 kinds, C5(b)). Kind order: machines (printing on paper, scanning, then 3D printing), then the supplies made for them, which shops sell in the same aisle ("printers, ink and toner").

name: External storage and media
axis: Leaf axis: none (9 kinds, C5(b)). Kind order: external drives, carried flash media, readers and housings, network storage, then disc and legacy drives.

name: Networking and backup power
axis: Leaf axis: none (8 kinds, C5(b)). Kind order: the path from the provider's line to the devices (modem, router, wireless coverage, wired distribution, power over the network), then the UPS that keeps the setup running.

name: Cables, adapters and chargers
axis: Leaf axis: none (10 kinds, C5(b); connector family becomes the leaf axis if harvest takes the sub-family above about 12 kinds). Kind order: cables by connector family (data and video, network, audio and music), then adapters and hubs, then generic chargers.

name: Electronics and maker parts
axis: Leaf axis: component family as the distributor catalogue groups it, maker boards and kits first (provisional until the Mouser harvest; loose components are carried to the Mouser class level).

name: Point of sale and security devices
axis: Leaf axis: none (6 kinds, C5(b)). Kind order: the till and what reads at it, then the devices that hold a person's keys. This sub-family is not in the owner's list of eight: the key names these objects for D1 and none of the eight aisles is where a buyer looks for them (shops sell them as a point-of-sale aisle and as security keys).

name: Parts and accessories made for one computer or peripheral
axis: Leaf axis: none (3 kinds); object served; exempt from the level-1 axis (C5(d)). It holds only parts made for one computer or peripheral that fit none of the shopper paths above.

name: Game machines
axis: Leaf axis: form of the machine (home, handheld, VR headset, arcade cabinet style, console add-on).

name: Controllers and input devices
axis: Leaf axis: type of input (the physical form of the controller).

name: Parts and accessories made for one game machine
Dogs
axis: Leaf axis: the function the object serves for a dog.

name: Cats
axis: Leaf axis: the function the object serves for a cat.

name: Small mammals
axis: Leaf axis: the function the object serves for a small mammal.

name: Horses and other equines
axis: Leaf axis: the function the object serves for a horse or other equine.

name: Fish and aquaria
axis: Leaf axis: the function the object serves for fish and their aquarium.

name: Reptiles and amphibians
axis: Leaf axis: the function the object serves for a reptile or amphibian and its enclosure.

name: Cage and aviary birds
axis: Leaf axis: the function the object serves for a caged or aviary bird. No kind is decided in the memo; the kinds come from the stage-3 harvest.

name: Wild birds and wildlife
axis: Leaf axis: the function the object serves for a wild bird or wild animal.

name: Bees
axis: Leaf axis: the function the object serves for bees or the beekeeper.

name: Poultry and other livestock (backyard)
axis: Leaf axis: the function the object serves for backyard poultry or other livestock.

name: Several animals
axis: Leaf axis: the function the object serves; the same vocabulary as the animal sub-families. For objects made for two or more animal groups.

name: Parts and accessories made for one B10 object
axis: Leaf axis: the B10 object the part is made for (the only sub-family exempt from the animal-group axis).

name: Optical & astronomical instruments
axis: Leaf axis: instrument type. Sub-family test: look through it or model the sky.

name: Binoculars & monoculars
axis: Kind axis: prism design or form. Magnification x aperture size class, ED glass, prism glass grade, coating, waterproofing, stabilisation and rangefinding are attributes.

name: Astronomical telescopes
axis: Kind axis: optical design. Aperture, glass class (achromat, ED, APO), GoTo or manual, and the `mount` of a complete set (alt-az, Dobsonian, equatorial) are attributes.

name: Microscopes
axis: Kind axis: principle. Mono, bino or trinocular head, objective grade and illumination are attributes; antique stand forms are named forms.

name: Magnifiers & loupes
axis: Kind axis: form in which the lens is held. Power, lens material, illumination and use (reading, jewellery, stamps, botany) are attributes or tags.

name: Weather instruments
axis: Leaf axis: quantity measured, with one leaf for stations that measure several (C14(c)). The sub-family reads the air and is C6 for a household or a farm alike.

name: Pressure
axis: Kind axis: mechanism.

name: Laboratory apparatus
axis: Leaf axis: what the item does to a sample (hold or measure it; weigh, separate, warm, cool, enclose or dissect it).

name: Science-education kits
axis: Leaf axis: none; the sub-family holds one kind, so the data stores `leaf = null` (C5(b)).

name: Parts and accessories made for one instrument
axis: Leaf axis: instrument served (S3; the closing sub-family, exempt from the level-1 axis, C5(d), CV-17).

name: Fixed fittings
axis: Leaf axis: where the fitting mounts (ceiling, wall, recessed or track, ground or post, rigged for a performance). Placement is a level here because each fitting is made only for its mount and its body differs.

name: Standing lamps
axis: Leaf axis: where the lamp stands (table or desk, floor). A lamp that plugs in or stands in place stays here whatever its power source.

name: Carried and worn lights
axis: Leaf axis: how the light is carried or used (hand, head, lantern, work light). Power source and setting (camping) are attributes.

name: Light sources
axis: Leaf axis: shape and cap form (general bulbs, reflector and spot and capsule bulbs, forms with their own holder or ballast, strips), in the order of the bulb shape codes. Technology, cap code, filament style, connectivity and colour are attributes.

name: Forms that need their own holder or ballast
Parts and accessories made for one lamp or fitting
System and device care
axis: Leaf axis: layer of the machine (operating environments, maintenance and recovery, files and remote access).

name: Creative production
axis: Leaf axis: medium (images and design; video and animation; audio and music), plus one leaf for an all-apps bundle across media (C14(b)).

name: Money and business
axis: Leaf axis: business function (never market: market is a tag). The three leaves are Capterra headline-group names, provisional on the recount of the headline groups; further leaves open at stage-3 harvest.

name: Development
axis: Leaf axis: part of the work (writing code; data and servers).

name: Parts and accessories made for one program or device
axis: Leaf axis: the host or device the add-on is made for (the one sub-family exempt from the level-1 axis; a leaf with one kind is allowed, R-11).

name: Fruit
axis: Leaf axis: crop group (botanical-culinary group as shops and standards use it).

name: Vegetables
axis: Leaf axis: crop group (botanical-culinary group as shops and standards use it).

name: Herbs
axis: Leaf axis: none (no leaf; about 5 kinds in the sourced set). A leaf is added only if the list passes 12 kinds.

name: Fungi and other edible organisms
axis: Leaf axis: none yet (no leaf). Once the sub-family passes 12 kinds the leaf axis is the kind of organism: edible fungi; sea vegetables; other edible organisms.

name: Mixed across sub-families (category level; sub-family = null, leaf = null)
Fresh, frozen & live seafood
axis: Leaf axis: animal group (finfish, crustaceans, molluscs, other aquatic invertebrates). Storage state (live, chilled, frozen, previously frozen), cut and presentation, wild or farmed and certification are attributes, not kinds. Order inside a leaf: canonical first, then the memo's secondary order (salmon first in finfish; species not stated first in crustaceans).

name: Salted, cured, dried & fermented fish & seafood
Roe & caviar
axis: Leaf axis: source fish group (the line CITES and EU law draw). Grain grade and cure are attributes; a producer's grade is a tier entry on its line. Order: sturgeon species Beluga, Osetra, Sevruga, then pressed caviar last; other roe by egg size, large to small.

name: Cream and butter
axis: Leaf axis: the milk-fat product (cream, or butter and ghee).

name: Cheese
axis: Leaf axis: family of the curd and its maturing, tested by the first-yes key in the order below (leaf numbers follow the order of the leaves, wet to dry, then blue and processed). The final kind Mixed cheeses has leaf = null and sits at leaf 0.

name: Dried and preserved dairy (provisional until attested, K-55)
Milk powders and infant formula (no leaf)
Plant-based alternatives
axis: Leaf axis: the animal-derived product replaced (drink, yoghurt, cheese, cream or creamer, egg).

name: Wristwatches
axis: Leaf axis: the defining complication or certified function, tested on the object, applied in the order Dive; Tourbillon and grande complication; Striking; Calendar and astronomical; Chronograph; Multi-zone; Time-only (A-23).

name: Carried watches
axis: Leaf axis: none: 4 kinds, so the leaf level is skipped (C5b); carried on the person, not on the wrist; kinds by case style.

name: Clocks
axis: Leaf axis: placement or mounting (floor, table or shelf, wall, portable, building-mounted); the body differs by mount (C12a).

name: Timing instruments
axis: Leaf axis: none: 7 kinds, so the leaf level is skipped (C5b); stand-alone or hand-held instruments that time an interval, record time or keep time without being a room clock.

name: Parts and accessories made for one watch or clock
axis: Leaf axis: none yet: 8 kinds, so the leaf level is skipped (C5b, CV-16); the stated axis for later use is the object served (watch; clock), CV-17. Exempt from the level-1 axis (C5d, S3).

name: Parts and accessories made for one bag
Head and hair
axis: Leaf axis: ornament family. Display group: Hair and head jewellery.

name: Ear
axis: Leaf axis: form family (earrings made for the lobe; cuffs and climbers). Display group: Earrings and ear cuffs.

name: Body and facial piercing jewellery
axis: Leaf axis: fitting form (barbell, ring, stud or labret, navel curve, stretched-ear piece). Holds every ornament made to be worn through a piercing other than an earring made for the earlobe, whoever sells it. Display group: Body jewellery (piercing).

name: Neck and chest
axis: Leaf axis: form family. Display group: Necklaces, pendants and chains.

name: Arm and wrist
axis: Leaf axis: form family (flexible or open bracelets; rigid closed or hinged bangles; upper-arm pieces). Display group: Bracelets, bangles and armlets.

name: Hand and finger
axis: Leaf axis: form family. Display group: Rings and hand jewellery.

name: Torso, waist and clothing
axis: Leaf axis: form family (pinned ornaments; shirt and tie pieces; chains round the waist). Display group: Brooches, pins and cufflinks; the waist chain is displayed in Anklets, toe rings and body chains, and its home stays here.

name: Leg and foot
axis: Leaf axis: form family. Display group: Anklets, toe rings and body chains.

name: Parts and accessories made for one jewellery piece
Skin care
axis: Leaf axis: the job in the care routine, for any body area (cleanse, tone, treat, moisturise, mask, protect); the last leaf holds the tools and devices. Face, eye, hand, foot and body products are one kind with `area` as the attribute.

name: Makeup
axis: Leaf axis: the area of the face or body coloured; the last leaf holds the tools and devices. A product that leaves visible colour, or that prepares or fixes makeup, is Makeup.

name: Hair care and styling
axis: Leaf axis: the job (wash and condition, colour and chemical, styling, hairpieces); the last leaf holds the hair tools, manual or powered (power source is an attribute).

name: Fragrance (no leaf)
axis: Kind axis: the format (H-4). The scent (house plus name) is a maker-bound named form; parfum or extrait, eau de parfum, eau de toilette, eau de cologne and eau fraîche are its concentration variants.

name: Shaving and hair removal
axis: Leaf axis: the method of removing or trimming hair; the last leaf holds the preparations and aftercare. Blades, cartridges, foils, heads and guards made for one razor or shaver are H1.10.

name: Body, bath and hygiene
axis: Leaf axis: the job (bathing, deodorising, intimate and menstrual hygiene, toileting and nappy changing); the last leaf holds the equipment. Baby is a user tag.

name: Grooming implements, mirrors and scales (no leaf)
Parts and accessories made for one <object>
axis: Leaf axis: the object served (C5(d), S3). A part made for one razor, shaver, clipper, toothbrush or dryer follows it here; the part type is the kind.

name: Instruments
axis: Leaf axis: the playing family, by how the sound is produced and how the instrument is played. World and traditional instruments are kinds in their playing family with a region tag (E-8); there is no world or tradition leaf, and the "by tradition" view is generated from region tags.

name: Amplification & effects
axis: Leaf axis: the job (amplify; modify the signal). Display group: Amps & effects.

name: Sound capture, mixing & reproduction
axis: Leaf axis: the job (capture with microphones; mix and interface; reproduce through loudspeakers; reproduce through headphones and in-ear monitors; process the signal; perform with DJ equipment; control other gear). Studio, stage and DJ settings are `use` tags, never a level.

name: Parts and accessories made for one instrument
Wine (grape)
axis: Leaf axis: wine class, by the first-yes key (aromatised; fortified; sweet; sparkling; orange; rosé; otherwise still red or still white by colour). axis: Kind axis: function (cool, or keep food and drink). Display group: Food storage; B5.3.01 and B5.3.02 display in Large kitchen appliances.

name: Serve, eat and drink at table
axis: Leaf axis: piece family in the place setting (dinnerware, flatware, glassware, cups, serveware and table accessories); kinds are piece types in place-setting order.

name: Dinnerware
axis: Kind axis: piece type. Display group: Dinnerware and serveware.

name: Flatware
axis: Kind axis: piece type. Display group: Dinnerware and serveware.

name: Glassware
axis: Kind axis: piece type; stemmed or stemless and lead crystal are attributes. Display group: Glassware and drinkware.

name: Cups

name: Serveware and table accessories
axis: Kind axis: piece type. Display group: Dinnerware and serveware.

name: Coffee equipment
axis: Kind axis: brew method, then operating mode (the three espresso modes are kinds under rule T(b)). Display group: Coffee and tea.

name: Tea equipment
axis: Kind axis: vessel form. Display group: Coffee and tea.

name: Water
axis: Kind axis: appliance type. Display group: Coffee and tea.

name: Bar tools
axis: Kind axis: bar tool. Display group: Bar and home brewing.

name: Home brewing and winemaking
axis: Kind axis: drink made (beer, wine, cider). Display group: Bar and home brewing. No kind is decided in the memo (K-58 sends the equipment to B5); the kinds come from the stage-3 harvest, and the leaf dissolves into its host if the harvest finds none.

name: Clean-up, kitchen wear and remainder (no leaf)
axis: Kind axis: function (kinds the key sends to B5 that fit no stage above). Display group: Clean-up and kitchen wear; B5.6.01 displays in Large kitchen appliances.

name: Parts and accessories made for one kitchen object (no leaf)
axis: Kind axis: the part itself; leaf axis when needed: object served (`leaf = null` while it holds about 12 kinds or fewer, CV-17, C5(d)). Display group: Replacement parts. No kind is decided in the memo; the sub-family dissolves into its host if the harvest finds none. Kinds to look for (no id, R-96 c), the memo's examples of what S3 sends here, each †: a coffee machine's portafilter, water tank or drip tray; the jar of one blender; the lid or base of one kettle; a lid made for one pot; a rack made for one appliance (section 14).

name: Writing, marking & correcting instruments
axis: Leaf axis: the marking or unmarking mechanism (liquid ink through a nib; viscous or gel ink through a ball; ink through a fibre, felt or brush tip; ink carried from a separate stone or well by a hair brush; solid core; removing, covering or sharpening). Kinds in order of increasing specialisation. Pens, nibs, brushes and inks are filed by the maker's first-named use (K-170): handwriting, lettering, calligraphy and shodo, or both writing and drawing, C5; drawing, comics or painting only, C4.

name: Paper goods
axis: Leaf axis: what the sheets are made to be (a bound book for notes; a time-ruled record; a loose sheet, a pad or a cover for posting sheets; a printed or decorated sheet). Tie-break: a bound book ruled by date is a diary or planner (it keeps time). Kinds simplest binding or form first. A blank paper good is C5; once written in it is a record in F5.

name: Desk accessories & filing
axis: Leaf axis: the job done at the desk (hold things, display on a board, handle sheets, fasten or stick, file, measure). Kinds commonest desk use first. Display group: Desk, filing and office supplies.

name: Calculators & office machines
axis: Leaf axis: what the device does (calculate; act on paper or labels). Kinds by spec ladder, then historical forms. Display group: Calculators and office machines.

name: Parts and accessories made for one object
axis: Leaf axis: object served (rule S3; consumables used up in one object, such as ink, refills and lead, are parts). Exempt from the sub-family axis (C5(d), CV-17). Kinds: the parts of the commonest object served first.

name: For ball, gel and rollerball pens
For one pen at a time
Structure, envelope & openings
axis: Leaf axis: the building-product group a seller shelves it in (frame and boards; sections; masonry; groundworks; roof, cladding and insulation; chimney and flue; openings; boundary). Kind axis: sheet, section or product type; species, thickness, grade and treatment are attributes.

name: Interior finishes & floors
axis: Leaf axis: the surface finished (wall, floor, trim). Kind axis: finish product type; tile material, PEI, slip and water-absorption ratings are attributes.

name: Fixings & fasteners
axis: Leaf axis: fastener type (screw, nail and staple, bolt-nut-washer, rivet, anchor, connector). Kind axis per leaf: screws by application (what they fasten into; provisional until attested, CV-25), anchors by mechanism, the rest by form; diameter, length, drive, head, material, coating and `property_class` (ISO 898-1) are attributes.

name: Door, window & building hardware
axis: Leaf axis: the hardware function (hinge, handle or knob, latch or bolt, bracket, plate or sign). Kind axis: hardware type; finish, material and era are attributes or tags.

name: Plumbing & drainage supplies
axis: Leaf axis: the part of the plumbing system (joint fittings, pipe, valves and taps, waste and drainage, shower and bath surrounds). Kind axis: joint fittings by joint system with shape an attribute (C-19, provisional until a fetched source compares the joint types); pipe diameter, material and `thread_standard` are attributes.

name: Electrical supplies
axis: Leaf axis: the electrical function (cable and flex, wiring accessory, distribution and leads). Kind axis: device or cable family; rating, gang count, core count and cross-section are attributes, plug and socket types named forms.

name: Paints, coatings & wood finishes
axis: Leaf axis: the coating or preparation job (paint, wood finish, surface preparation). Kind axis: paints by surface and use (provisional until attested, CV-25); `binder` (emulsion, solvent, alkyd), EN 13300 classes, `gloss_level`, colour and special properties such as anti-mould are attributes.

name: Adhesives, sealants & fillers
axis: Leaf axis: the bonding or sealing job (adhesives; sealants and fillers). Kind axis: adhesives by use (provisional until attested, CV-25); `chemistry` (silicone, acrylic, polyurethane), pack size and interior or exterior are attributes.

name: Batteries & chargers
axis: Leaf axis: cell shape (cylindrical, button and coin, rectangular and block; the shape letter of the IEC designation), plus the leaf Chargers (K-3). Kind axis: the standard size class buyers ask for by name (CV-19); chemistry, `rechargeable`, voltage and capacity are attributes; coin designations are named forms, product lines are lines rows.

name: Fuels, lubricants & firelighting
axis: Leaf axis: the role in burning: fuel by form (bottled gas, solid fuel, liquid fuel and lubricant) or the means of lighting it (Firelighting, C-7). Kind axis: fuel form and product, or lighting means; `gas`, `valve`, bottle size, wood species, bag weight and brand are attributes.

name: Tractors & carriers
axis: Leaf axis: running gear. Kind axis: design for a task, canonical form first, then by increasing specialisation; size and power are attributes (C-6). Display group: Tractors and carriers.

name: Soil tillage
axis: Leaf axis: operation on the ground. Kind axis: implement type, most generic first; working width, mounted or trailed and reversible or fixed are attributes. Display group: Soil tillage.

name: Seeding and planting (no leaf)
axis: Kind axis: machine type. Display group: Seeding and planting.

name: Crop care (no leaf)
axis: Kind axis: machine type; `carrier` is an attribute. Display group: Spreading, spraying and irrigation.

name: Harvesting (no leaf)
axis: Kind axis: machine type; a header or head that does a job of its own is its own kind. Display group: Harvesting.

name: Hay and forage (no leaf)
axis: Kind axis: machine type. Display group: Hay and forage.

name: Post-harvest handling (no leaf)
axis: Kind axis: machine type. Display group: Grain and post-harvest.

name: Livestock and dairy
axis: Leaf axis: stage of the herd, flock or dairy chain. Kind axis: herd-scale function and installation form. Display group: Livestock and dairy.

name: Forestry (no leaf)
axis: Kind axis: machine type; `boom_type` and the forestry system (cut-to-length against whole-tree) are an attribute and a view. Forestry holds 14 kinds with `leaf = null` (CV-16, A-21). Display group: Forestry machines.

name: Parts and accessories made for one machine
axis: Leaf axis: the machine served (exempt from the job axis, C5(d), CV-17). A fitting with no job of its own away from its host machine is here; an attachment that does a job of its own keeps its job sub-family. Display group: Loaders, tyres and tractor fittings.

name: Firearms
axis: Leaf axis: form class of the whole firearm (pistol, revolver, rifle, shotgun, combination gun, blank-firing pistol). Kinds by action within the form, from the simplest action to self-loading; `ignition` (flintlock, percussion, cartridge), calibre, capacity and barrel length are attributes. Display group: Firearms.

name: Air and gas guns
axis: Leaf axis: form class (rifle, pistol). Powerplant is a kind only where it changes the body or needs new fittings (C10): a reservoir and filling equipment for PCP, a capsule housing for CO2; spring and gas piston are one kind with `piston_type` an attribute. Display group: Air & gas guns.

name: Bows and crossbows
axis: Leaf axis: bow (hand-drawn), crossbow (stock-mounted) or other hand-held launcher (K-84). Draw weight, draw length, let-off and handedness are attributes; Olympic, 3D and bowhunting are disciplines (use tags). Display group: Bows, crossbows & arrows.

name: Swords
axis: Leaf axis: blade profile (straight double-edged; single-edged; thrusting). Hilt length (one-handed, hand-and-a-half, two-handed) and `function_class` are attributes; region and era are tags; school is a school-table link. Regional names (jian, dao, liuyedao, dadao, shamshir, kilij, talwar) and lettered typologies (Oakeshott types, blade-construction names) are named forms. Display group: Swords.

name: Polearms, axes and impact weapons
axis: Leaf axis: form class by handling (polearm; axe; staff; impact; flexible), following the long, short and flexible classes of the Chinese apparatus lists. Display group: Polearms, axes & impact weapons.

name: Armour and shields
axis: Leaf axis: part of the body protected, or hand-held (head; torso; limbs and hands; full body; shields). Era is not a leaf; `protection_level` is an attribute with the standard and edition named. Display group: Body armour, historical armour & shields.

name: Parts, fittings and accessories
axis: Leaf axis: weapon class served (C5(d)), with one leaf for fittings made for more than one weapon class (C14(b); axis inside it: fitting function). The platform (AR-15 pattern, rail interface, magazine pattern, bow cam system) is a C13 row. Display group: Parts, optics & fittings.

axis: Leaf axis: the object served (CV-17, C5(d)); further hosts open at harvest. Display group: Parts & accessories for one object (display position 17).

name: Land vehicles
axis: Leaf axis: the kind of vehicle by body and drive, as it is sold; the legal registration class, mass band and seat count are never the axis (C6, C17).

name: Cars
axis: Kind axis: body style, in UNECE bodywork-code order AA to AF, then others. Display group: Cars.

name: Vans, trucks and buses
axis: Kind axis: body; gross mass and seat count are attributes, and the UNECE class is a C17 row (G-9). Display group: Vans, trucks and buses.

name: Motorcycles and other powered light vehicles
axis: Kind axis: type. Display group: Motorcycles, scooters and powered light rides.

name: Off-road, snow and utility vehicles
axis: Kind axis: terrain and seating. Display group: Off-road, snow and utility vehicles.

name: Bicycles
axis: Kind axis: discipline or use; a cycle made to be pedalled, with or without electric assist, is filed here by its discipline (P2). Display group: Bicycles and other cycles (with the "Electric bikes" shortcut view on `assist`).

name: Other human-powered cycles
axis: Kind axis: wheel and seat layout. Display group: Bicycles and other cycles.

name: Trailers
axis: Kind axis: load carried; the mass band O1 to O4 is a C17 row. Display group: Caravans, motorhomes and trailers.

name: Caravans, motorhomes and campers
axis: Kind axis: body, and whether towed or driven. Display group: Caravans, motorhomes and trailers.

name: Animal-drawn vehicles
axis: Kind axis: who or what moves it. Display group: Rail and horse-drawn vehicles.

name: Hand-pushed carriers
axis: Kind axis: seat or lie, and number of occupants. Display group: Prams and strollers.

name: Watercraft

name: Paddle and oar craft
axis: Kind axis: hull; a paddle craft keeps its hull kind whatever its drive (paddle, pedal or electric motor as `propulsion`, P13). Display group: Boats and watercraft.

name: Sailing craft
axis: Kind axis: hull configuration and accommodation; rig and length are attributes. Display group: Boats and watercraft.

name: Motor craft
axis: Kind axis: use class, cleaned from YachtWorld's list. Display group: Boats and watercraft.

name: Aircraft
axis: Leaf axis: two leaves, airplanes and other aircraft.

name: Airplanes
axis: Kind axis: engine class; C10(b) applies. Display group: Aircraft.

name: Other aircraft
axis: Kind axis: how it flies (the FAA category). Display group: Aircraft.

name: Parts and accessories made for one vehicle
Vibrators and suction stimulators
axis: Leaf axis: the body area the stimulation touches (external, internal, both at once). Sub-family test: vibrates, pulses or sucks, and no earlier sub-family takes it. Display group: Vibrators and suction stimulators.

name: Penis toys
axis: Leaf axis: how the object meets the penis (enclosing, ring or sleeve, pump). Sub-family test: worn on, around or enclosing the penis. Display group: Penile products.

name: Restraint, impact and sensation gear
axis: Leaf axis: what it does to the partner (restrain or suspend, deprive, impact or sensation, lock, electro-stimulate); kinds inside a leaf from mildest to most restrictive, furniture last in H3.5.1 and the intimate oil last in H3.5.3. Material (steel, neoprene, silk, leather), lining and `release_type` are attributes. Display group: Restraint, impact and sensation gear.

name: Parts and accessories made for one adult object
Printed volumes and serials
axis: Leaf axis: the form in which the printed carrier is issued or read (book, comic or manga edition, periodical, printed music).

name: Books
axis: Kind axis: binding class. Display group: Books. Trim class (ONIX B101 to B114, bunko B111 and shinsho B112 included), `paper_class`, `format_size` (folio to sextodecimo) and binding material are attributes. Enter at harvest (no id yet): fold-out book (ONIX BO), part-work (BN), novelty book (BK).

name: Comic and manga editions
axis: Kind axis: edition form. Display group: Comics and manga. Tankōbon, wide-ban, bunkoban, kanzenban, gōka aizōban, sōshūhen, the bande dessinée album and the publishers' lines are named forms.

name: Periodicals and newspapers
axis: Kind axis: periodical form. Display group: Magazines, newspapers and zines. `page_format` (broadsheet, Berliner, tabloid, journal size, digest, A5, B5) is an attribute; single and back issues are individual items. Held out of the tree until a page is fetched (no id): mook or bookazine.

name: Printed music
axis: Kind axis: completeness of the notation. Display group: Sheet music. Instrumentation, level, urtext and facsimile are attributes; method and tutor books are books (F1-O2). Enter at harvest (no id yet): piano reduction, single part. Held out of the tree until a page is fetched (no id): fake book (filed meanwhile as F1.1.4.07 with `notation = lead sheet`).

name: Cartographic items
axis: Leaf axis: the form in which the cartographic carrier is issued (sheet map, bound atlas, globe). `scope` (reference, road, street, walking, cycling, thematic), map style, series and region are attributes or named forms.

name: Maps
axis: Kind axis: physical form. Display group: Maps, atlases and globes (level-2 group Maps). Enter at harvest (no id yet): tear-off map pad, custom map.

name: Atlases
axis: Kind axis: binding. Display group: Maps, atlases and globes (level-2 group Atlases).

name: Globes
axis: Kind axis: mount. Display group: Maps, atlases and globes (level-2 group Globes). `body` (terrestrial, celestial, lunar, planetary), `map_style`, `illuminated`, `relief`, diameter and `bar_cabinet` are attributes of all globes.

name: Sound carriers
axis: Leaf axis: the recording technology of the carrier (grooved disc or cylinder, magnetic tape, optical disc, solid-state device). `content_type` (music, spoken word, audiobook, other sound) is an attribute of every sound kind; there is no audiobook kind (F-8).

name: Grooved discs and cylinders
axis: Kind axis: groove standard, which decides the stylus and the deck. Display group: Vinyl and other records. `diameter`, `speed`, `release_type`, `weight_g`, `mastering`, colour and pressing are attributes. Enter at harvest (no id yet): Edison Disc, Pathé Disc, Mighty Tiny, Sopic.

name: Magnetic tape (audio)
axis: Kind axis: tape system. Display group: Cassettes and tapes. `tape_type` (IEC I to IV) is an attribute. Enter at harvest (no id yet): Elcaset, DAT, DCC, ADAT, DTRS, open-reel tape, 8-track cartridge.

name: Optical audio discs
axis: Kind axis: disc system. Display group: CDs and other audio discs. `encoding`, `pressing_material`, `bit_depth`, `sample_rate` and `hybrid` are attributes. Enter at harvest (no id yet): CDr, MiniDisc.

name: Solid-state sound carriers
axis: Kind axis: device type (a carrier that holds one work fixed on it and plays it). Display group: CDs and other audio discs (display move). A player that plays any loaded content is D3.

name: Moving-image carriers
axis: Leaf axis: the recording technology of the carrier (videotape, video disc, motion-picture film). Video region codes are C13 platform rows (DVD regions, Blu-ray A to C); Steelbook packaging is an attribute.

name: Videotape
axis: Kind axis: tape system. Display group: Films and video (level-2 group videotape). Enter at harvest (no id yet): S-VHS, Video 2000, Video8, U-matic, MiniDV, Cartrivision.

name: Video discs
axis: Kind axis: disc system. Display group: Films and video (level-2 group video discs). Enter at harvest (no id yet): VCD, SVCD, HD DVD, UMD video, CED SelectaVision, VHD, CDV.

name: Motion-picture film
axis: Kind axis: gauge, which fixes the projector (C6, CV-19). Display group: Films and video (level-2 group film prints). Sound, base and colour are attributes. Enter at harvest (no id yet): regular 8 mm, 9.5 mm, 28 mm.

name: Parts and accessories made for one carrier
axis: Leaf axis: the object served (book, comic, record, disc, globe). Exempt from the level-1 axis (C5(d), CV-17). Display group: Sleeves, jackets and cases for one item. All kinds are † (no fetched page names them). Holders made for several carriers are B1.

name: Parts and accessories made for one artwork
Coins
axis: Leaf axis: standing of the issue (circulating; collector; local and emergency; copies). Ancient and medieval coins share these kinds with `era` and `issuer` tags (F-14); denomination is an attribute; a roll or bag of like coins is the coin with `unit` (F3-7). Display group: Coins.

name: Banknotes and paper money
axis: Leaf axis: standing of the issue (circulating; non-circulating; local; copies). Paper circulated as money by a non-currency issuer is F3.4.4.01 (F-16); paper or polymer substrate is an attribute. Display group: Banknotes and paper money.

name: Tokens and scrip
axis: Leaf axis: what the token stands for (a service; trade and wages; tax and dues; money issued by a non-currency issuer). The business served (milk, beer, bread, pharmacy) is the attribute `business`; `issuer_type` is an attribute of F3.4.4.01. Display group: Tokens and scrip.

name: Postage and postal items
axis: Leaf axis: postal item type (adhesive stamp; stamp unit; postal stationery; cover; fiscal label); inside Adhesive stamps the axis is issue class. `issue_class`, `postal_service` and `unit` are attributes; plate block is a `unit` value (section 14). Display group: Stamps and postal items.

name: Medals and decorations
axis: Leaf axis: purpose (honours and decorations; service; commemorative and art; award and membership; insignia of office, folded in from the former Regalia sub-family, F-15). Kinds follow the generic purpose ladder (section 8); regime or period, full-size or miniature and original or replica are attributes; a named group to one recipient and a particular mace are individual items and out. Display group: Medals, orders and insignia.

name: Trading cards
axis: Leaf axis: product form (single cards; collectible stickers; sealed product). Sport, league and franchise are tags; card build, rookie status and `product_form` are attributes; a complete factory set is the card kind with `unit` = set; product lines are C1 line rows; parallels and numbered cards are C3 variants. Display group: Trading cards and stickers.

name: Parts and accessories made for one coin, note, stamp, medal or card
axis: Leaf axis: object served (coin and note; stamp; medal; card) (C5(d)), then part type. Size and material are attributes. Display group: Holders, slabs and mounts for one item.

name: Issued documents
axis: Leaf axis: the fact the document proves (identity and right to travel; a life event; a right or obligation; a standing conferred; who the holder is or what site they may enter). Sub-family axis: what the object is for, it proves a fact. `document_class` DS applies to the issued documents.

name: Cards, passes & tokens
axis: Leaf axis: what the card gives access to (funds, stored value, transit, a benefit, a lock or network). Sub-family axis: what the object is for, it gives access to an account, service, place or stored value. F5 whether live, used or expired; the balance or entitlement behind the card is OUT or I3. `technology` (magnetic, chip, optical, contactless), `acceptance` and ISO/IEC 7810 format are attributes.

name: Personal records & keepsake papers
axis: Leaf axis: how the record was made or what it holds (written or drawn; photographic; recorded; compiled; printed and kept). Sub-family axis: what the object is for, it keeps a record of a person's life. Being written on, drawn on or recorded on is not condition.

name: Minerals
axis: Leaf axis: chemical class (Strunz, 10 classes, in Strunz order, with the class wording the memo takes from S13; decided in F-24, provisional until the quartz-family placement is read). Kinds are uncut species or major varieties; each mineral kind carries a `strunz_code`. A loose faceted, cabochon or cutting-rough stone is F6.5; every other piece (crystal, cluster, specimen on matrix, geode, tumbled stone, slab, sphere, egg, palm stone) is here under its species, even when the species is a gem (F-4). Inside a leaf kinds are shown by Strunz division and then A to Z (section 8); an A to Z view is generated. Enter at harvest (no id yet): the further species and varieties sellers list (about 250 to 450 kinds; section 4).

name: Rocks
axis: Leaf axis: rock class by origin (igneous, sedimentary, metamorphic), with the value "mixed classes" for the one kit kind that spans them. A set of like specimens is the rock with a `quantity` attribute, not a kind. Enter at harvest (no id yet): the further rock types of the teaching kits and rock sellers (about 50 to 70 kinds; section 4).

name: Fossils and fossil resin
axis: Leaf axis: the kind of organism or trace the fossil was (invertebrate, vertebrate, plant, trace and microbial, fossil resin). Amber and ammolite stay here in every cut state, so a cabochon of either is not F6.5 (F-4). An unworked fossil is F6 whatever it is kept for (F-17). Enter at harvest (no id yet): the further organism groups of the fossil sellers (about 60 to 90 kinds; section 4).

name: Gemstones and pearls, unset
axis: Leaf axis: the grading scheme the trade applies (diamond, coloured stone, pearl). Holds a loose stone that is faceted or cut en cabochon, or rough sold as cutting material by weight (F-4), natural, cultured or laboratory-grown (`origin_type`); every other mineral piece is F6.1, and amber and ammolite are F6.3. Colour, carat, shape, clarity, cut, `treatment` and report type are attributes; a drilled bead is C4, a mounted or strung stone A3.

name: Shells and other marine hard parts
axis: Leaf axis: the kind of animal that made the hard part (gastropod, bivalve, other mollusc, echinoderm and coral). The species is a named form; a single shell with its species identified is F6, an unsorted assortment for crafts C4 (K-78). Enter at harvest (no id yet): the further families and popular groups of the shell dealers (about 40 to 80 kinds; section 4).

name: Preserved biological specimens
axis: Leaf axis: how the specimen is preserved (mount, skeletal and other hard parts, pinned and dried, pressed, encased, fluid-preserved). The animal group is an attribute except where sellers split it, as for mounts; the species is an attribute. Every kind can carry C17 ledger rows (CITES appendix by species, ivory regimes), shown as a generated flag. A mount of one animal prepared as in life is here however it is presented; a composition of animal parts with other materials is F2 (K-76).

Finfish: salmon, trout and charr
